theme:ai-power.value: 2026-11-12 Bloom Energy closed up 12.97% at 209.47 on Nov 11 on 18.8 million shares, about 1.4 times Nov 10's volume, and Vertiv rose 6.33% to 206.51 as CoreWeave's results revived the data center trade (Massive; TradingKey). MarketBeat put Bloom's volume about 35% above average.
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-11-11 Siemens Energy posted record fiscal Q4 revenue of 12.83 billion euros, up 21.5%, with orders of 14.8 billion euros and up to 9 billion euros of new buybacks through 2030; its CEO said he has no doubt more US data centers will be built (CNBC, Nov 11). SoftBank booked a 597.2 billion yen loss tied to changing plans for power equipment it had bought ahead for US AI data centers (CNBC).

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-11-10 Rockwell Automation's CEO filed a Form 4 on Nov 9 (EDGAR). The dashboard reads it as an open market buy of about $1.55 million at $386.36 on Nov 9, raising his stake about 4%; his last open market buy found was in February 2024. ROK closed 389.36 on Nov 9 on 1.44 million shares (Massive).
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-30 North American robot orders rose 25% in Q3 2026, and collaborative robots reached 1,831 units worth $63.8 million, up about 56% in units from a year earlier (Metrology News, Oct 30).

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-11-13 Three MP Materials insiders bought about $3.35 million on Nov 10, filed Nov 12: a director about $1.98 million at $36.00, the COO about $1.18 million at $36.72 and the CFO about $199,000 at $36.25 (SEC Form 4s via dashboard; GuruFocus). The stock was down 44% in six months; it closed 37.45 on Nov 12, up 1.96% on about 1.6 times normal volume (Yahoo). China's pause on its gallium, germanium and antimony ban to the US still ends Nov 27 with no extension found.
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-11-09 China's commerce ministry and customs extended the suspension of the October 2025 rare earth export measures, due to end Nov 10, to Jan 10, as part of a wider pause in trade countermeasures (Reuters via ThePrint, Business Standard, Nov 9). That includes the 0.1% foreign content rule (No. 61). The April 2025 licenses on seven medium and heavy rare earths stay in force.

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-11-05 Defense stocks fell on Nov 4 on fears a Democratic Congress trims the Pentagon budget: Lockheed fell 6.88%, L3Harris 6.46%, Northrop 4.53% and RTX 2.64% (Massive). Jefferies expects the 2027 budget nearer the House's roughly $1.15 trillion than the $1.5 trillion request, and TD Cowen called Golden Dome and Golden Fleet most at risk and nuclear modernization least at risk (Reuters via US News).
theme:defense-reshoring.was: 2026-11-04 Democrats won control of the House and Senate on Nov 3 (CBS, CNN), so a Democratic Congress will set defense budgets and oversight from January while the President keeps his veto. Defense names lagged before the open on Nov 4 (CNBC). Two Boeing directors bought about $1.5 million of stock near $172 on Oct 30, filed Nov 3 (dashboard).

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-11-13 The Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital gave Rocket Lab a $150 million conditional loan commitment on Nov 9 to scale Neutron production and flight rate; funding still has conditions and Neutron's first flight is in 2027 (Satnews; Defense Daily). Separately, the FAA had not published the license change Starship Flight 15 needs as of Nov 12, ahead of a 5:45pm ET Nov 13 window (NASASpaceflight).
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-11-12 The FCC accepted for filing SpaceX's application to buy 546 Grain Management 800 MHz licenses covering about 100% of the US population (about $8 billion). It is not approval: petitions to deny are due Dec 1, oppositions Dec 8 and replies Dec 15 (Benzinga, Nov 11).

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-11-05 Medtech, hospitals and Medicaid insurers rallied on Nov 4 on bets a Democratic Congress delays Medicaid cuts: Intuitive Surgical rose 9.38%, Stryker 9.37%, HCA 10.34%, Medtronic 6.15%, Dexcom 6.64% and Insulet 6.56% (Massive; Investrade). Zoetis reported Q3 this morning: revenue $2.39 billion, down 1%, adjusted EPS $1.75 against $1.51 expected by Zacks, and it raised full year adjusted EPS guidance to $6.25 to $6.35 (AP).
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-11-04 Insulet's Q3 revenue was $842.0 million, up 19.2% and above its own guidance range; international Omnipod grew 31.7% and US Omnipod 14.7%; adjusted EPS rose 59.9% to $1.99 and adjusted operating margin rose 4.9 points to 22.0% (Insulet, Nov 4).

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-11-13 Nvidia's CEO resigned on Nov 12; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Harvey Jones the first board chair (CNBC). NVDA hit 148.80 at the open and closed 166.19, down 4.34%, on 742.8 million shares, while AMD rose 5.86% to 585.30 and AVGO 5.54% to 364.36 (Yahoo). After the close Cisco raised its hyperscaler AI revenue outlook to $9 billion this fiscal year, more than double last year, Applied Materials reported record revenue of $10.41 billion and guided about $11.1 billion, and Cerebras grew revenue 55% and raised its outlook (CNBC; company releases; StockTitan). Coherent's CEO bought about $997,000 of stock at $199.48 on Nov 9 (SEC Form 4).
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-11-12 Nebius beat on Q3 revenue ($980.8 million vs a $907.5 million forecast) but guided 2026 revenue to the low end of $3.0 to $3.4 billion and raised 2026 capex to $27 billion from $20 to $25 billion, with $40 to $45 billion planned for 2027 (CNBC; company release, Nov 12). NBIS fell about 10% before the open after closing 154.69, up 15.44%, on Nov 11 (Massive). Separately, Nvidia's board met Nov 11 on its CEO's future after a second reported relationship; no decision was announced by about 8:30am ET Nov 12 and NVDA traded about 6% to 7% lower before the open (Yahoo Finance; Reuters).

theme:glp1-obesity.value: 2026-11-13 Lilly broke ground on a $3.5 billion plant in Pennsylvania's Lehigh Valley to make injectable obesity medicines including retatrutide, with about 850 jobs and operations expected by 2031 (Lilly release, Nov 12). It is Lilly's tenth new US site since 2020.
theme:glp1-obesity.was: 2026-11-12 China's drug regulator approved Lilly's oral GLP-1 orforglipron for adult weight management, the first oral GLP-1 for obesity approved there; a type 2 diabetes filing is under review (Lilly China via PharmaPhorum and European Pharmaceutical Review, Nov 12). LLY rose about 2.8% before the open (Investing.com via Yahoo).

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-11-13 Bitcoin fell as much as 5.4% to $67,628 on Nov 13, its lowest since Aug 19 and over 21% below late September highs, as more than $1 billion of leveraged longs were liquidated (Free Malaysia Today; CryptoSlate). IBIT fell 4.45% to 40.36 on Nov 12 on 55.9 million shares (Yahoo).
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-11-11 NYSE picked Avalanche to run clearing and settlement for its planned 24/7 tokenized stock platform, pending regulatory approval, targeted before the end of 2026 (Wall Street Journal via Yahoo Finance). ICE rose 1.34% to 176.36 on Nov 10 (Massive). A Galaxy Digital director also bought about $70,000 at $13.98, filed Nov 10, joining the CEO's $9.86 million buy (dashboard).

industry:agriculture-food.value: 2026-11-08 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Beyond Meat's Q3 revenue fell 8.1% to $64.5 million and its Q4 guide midpoint of $56.5 million is lower again (SEC 8-K, Nov 4). CF's Q3 urea price averaged $423 a ton against $593 in Q2, as buyers priced Gulf supply coming back (CF 10-Q), which weakens the near term cost case for nitrogen-fixing microbes; the weekend Gulf strikes could reverse that. Novonesis grew 6% organically in Q3 and kept its 7% to 8% year guide. No Mexico or Japan approval for the PRRS-resistant pig was found. Deere reports Nov 25. No stage moves.
industry:agriculture-food.was: 2026-10-29 Rechecked on the daily rotation. AGCO's Q3 (Oct 29) sales fell 8.6% to $2.26 billion, with Latin America down 19.1% and Brazil tractor retail sales down 17% for nine months; it kept its 2026 outlook and targets $2 billion of PTx retrofit sales by 2029 from about $1 billion this year. About 29% of global urea trade normally passes Hormuz (S&P Global), which keeps the cost case for nitrogen-fixing biologicals alive. No stage moves: the PRRS pig still waits on Mexico and Japan, and Corteva reports Nov 11.

industry:communications.value: 2026-11-10 AST SpaceMobile now targets about 45 BlueBird satellites in orbit by mid 2027, not end of 2026; Q3 revenue was $42.3 million, and launch deals cover more than 100 satellites for 2027 and 2028 (AST 8-K, Nov 9). No stage move: the network is still being built.
industry:communications.was: 2026-11-02 Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum for $115 billion in stock, combining Marvell's electrical chips with Lumentum's lasers and optics for AI data centers. Marvell says the deal lifts its addressable market to $550 billion (company release via CNBC, Nov 2). It is the largest bet yet that optical links become the chokepoint inside AI clusters.

industry:consumer.value: 2026-11-09 Rotation recheck. The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 myopia drop met Oct 30 with FDA reviewers calling the benefit 'limited to no clinical benefit' (Healio); no vote count or decision was found. Hims reports Q3 tonight against its own $880 million to $900 million revenue guide. Oura has set no new IPO date since Sep 29. No stage moves: no new approvals or revenue data.
industry:consumer.was: 2026-10-30 Rotation recheck. EssilorLuxottica's Q3 wearables revenue was 486 million euros, up 20% but a sharp slowdown in smart glasses growth (Reuters, Oct 20). Dexcom's Q3 revenue rose 11% to $1.3445 billion and it raised its 2026 guide to $5.20 billion to $5.25 billion (Oct 29). The FDA panel on SYD-101 meets Oct 30 with FDA doubts on the data (Pink Sheet). Oura still has no IPO date. No stage moves.

industry:defense-security.value: 2026-11-10 Rechecked on the daily rotation. After the Nov 3 midterms, industry and government officials told Ars Technica they expect the new Democratic majority to set limits on Golden Dome funding and possibly strip out boost phase space based interceptors, the costliest part; two of its top backers in Congress are leaving (KeepTrack citing Ars Technica, Nov 10). The other four innovations had no new hard evidence: the HACM first flight (Oct 5) and LOCUST X3 timing are already logged. No stage moves.
industry:defense-security.was: 2026-10-31 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Missile defense production money keeps growing on multiyear terms: L3Harris got seven year contracts of $6.3 billion for THAAD propulsion and $4.7 billion for PAC-3 MSE propulsion, holds a record $53.2 billion backlog and opened a new solid rocket motor plant in Arkansas; it also booked more than $500 million of VAMPIRE counter drone orders (Defence Industry Europe, Oct 30). The US approved a $2.1 billion Patriot sale to Ukraine (Reuters, Oct 30). No stage moves: this is production money for fielded interceptors, while hypersonics and space based defense still wait on tests and the full year budget.

industry:energy.value: 2026-11-11 Rotation check. Fervo's Q3 (Nov 9): first 33 MW Cape Station block in commercial operation and a new Google power deal that lifts binding contracts to 1,054 MW, about $11.9 billion, from 658 MW; revenue was only $116,000 and cash is $1.9 billion. NuScale's Q3 revenue was $0.3 million with no binding TVA deal yet, and Oklo's loss was narrower than forecast. No stage moves: geothermal stays early adoption and SMRs stay pilot.
industry:energy.was: 2026-11-01 Rotation check. Oracle's Project Jupiter cleared a step: on Oct 26 a New Mexico hearing officer refused to dismiss its air permit application, after an Oct 14 redesign that cuts emissions about 35% and uses 1,600 MW of Bloom fuel cells instead of the 2,462 MW allocated (Santa Fe New Mexican). The state decision is due Nov 23 but may slip to Dec 18, with a public hearing from Dec 7. Dates set: NuScale Nov 5, Oklo Nov 6 and Fervo Nov 9 report Q3; the TAE and Trump Media vote is listed for Dec 14. No stage moves.

industry:financials.value: 2026-11-04 Daily rotation recheck. Upstart's Q3 originations rose 44% to $4.1 billion but slipped from Q2's $4.2 billion, and the CEO said the economy weighs on the near term outlook, though net income was $36.6 million (SEC 8-K, Nov 3). NiCE's Q3 AI recurring revenue grew 46% to $392 million while total revenue grew 8.0%, and it raised full year EPS guidance (Nov 4). DTCC's October tokenization launch is still not confirmed.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-27 SoFi launched SOFIE on Oct 22, which it calls the first national bank issued tokenized deposit for consumers: each token is $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, FDIC insured, paying 4.40% APY, and can be converted 1:1 into its SoFiUSD stablecoin, which ends the yield and the insurance (SoFi, The Block). Rollout to its crypto customers finishes in November.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-11-05 Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill sold DKK 5.39 billion in Q3, above the DKK 4.62 billion forecast, and lifted combined US Wegovy sales 21% even as the injection fell 13%. Novo raised its 2026 sales guide and cuts US list prices for Wegovy and Ozempic to $675 a month from Jan 1, 2027 (CNBC, Nov 4).
industry:healthcare.was: 2026-10-29 Lilly's Q3 revenue rose 39% to $24.4 billion, driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound, and it raised 2026 revenue guidance to $91 billion to $92 billion from $85 billion to $87 billion, its third raise this year (company release, Quartz). West Pharmaceutical, which supplies pen and vial components, also beat and raised.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-11-13 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Stratasys and Nano Dimension terminated the $42.5 million Markforged purchase on Nov 11, citing longer and costlier regulatory approval (VoxelMatters; Stratasys Q3). Symbotic confirmed it reports fiscal Q4 on Nov 23 after the close (company, Oct 29). Musk said Nov 6 Tesla will likely rent Optimus robots, at an initial cost of about $30,000 each falling toward $20,000 (Not a Tesla App; Forbes). PTC's vote on Schneider's $205 a share offer still has no date. No stage changes.
industry:industrials.was: 2026-11-03 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Symbotic has not set its fiscal Q4 date (a third party site lists Nov 23, unconfirmed); it guided Q4 revenue to $760 to $780 million. Stratasys has not announced the close of its $42.5 million Markforged purchase, and PTC has not set the shareholder vote on Schneider's $205 a share cash offer. No stage changes: none of the four innovations has new cost, approval or revenue data since Oct 26.

industry:materials.value: 2026-11-05 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Navitas Q3 2026 revenue was $14.0 million, up 38% from a year earlier and above guidance, with high power revenue up more than 50% from Q2; it guides Q4 to $16.0 million (SEC filings). Still tiny, so the stage stays early adoption.
industry:materials.was: 2026-10-27 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel reported Q3 on Oct 21: sales about $496 million, up 8.8%, adjusted EPS $0.50 against $0.37, commercial aerospace up about 21% and defense and space down about 9%. It kept 2026 guidance, but shares fell about 11% to 12% as sales missed the roughly $502 million forecast (SEC filing, Investing.com).

industry:space.value: 2026-11-13 The Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital gave Rocket Lab a $150 million conditional loan commitment on Nov 9 to scale Neutron production; it is the third such space loan in about three weeks, after one to Stoke Space (Satnews; Defense Daily). The FAA had not published Starship Flight 15's license change as of Nov 12 (NASASpaceflight). No stage change until a catch succeeds.
industry:space.was: 2026-11-08 The Nov 8 planning date for Starship Flight 15 passed without a launch; a window is now listed for Friday Nov 13, 5:45pm to 7:00pm EST, pending regulatory approval, with Ship 42 and Booster 22 trying to catch both stages (Space Launch Schedule, updated Nov 7; a Nov 8 newsletter citing SpaceX and SpaceNews). No stage move until a catch succeeds.

industry:technology.value: 2026-11-07 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Qualcomm's fiscal Q4 (Nov 4): revenue $10.32 billion, down 8%; handset chips $5.14 billion, down 26%; automotive $1.99 billion, up 89%; IoT up 4%. It guided fiscal Q1 2027 to $10.4 billion to $11.2 billion and repeated a $5 billion data center revenue target for fiscal 2027 (SEC 8-K). The stage does not change: phone weakness offsets car and data center growth.
industry:technology.was: 2026-10-29 Marvell is in advanced talks to buy Lumentum, a maker of lasers for data center optics, with a deal possibly announced next week (Reuters, Oct 28). If it closes, a major chip designer would own a key laser supplier for optical links, including co-packaged optics. MRVL fell over 11% and LITE rose over 6% premarket Oct 29 (TradingKey). The stage does not change: this is a deal, not new revenue.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-11-12 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Joby and Archer now point to 2027 for early US passenger operations; Archer's Nov 9 FAA certificate covers only runway takeoffs and landings, and Joby's Q3 revenue outside its Blade helicopter unit was $1.9 million (AIN, Nov 10). Tesla's robotaxi now runs 24 hours a day in eight cities, and its Texas registry count (1,303) matched Waymo's (1,305) on Nov 12. The FAA drone rule still has no date.
industry:transportation.was: 2026-11-02 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Aurora's Q3 letter (Oct 28) moved its 200 driverless truck goal from the end of 2026 to the end of February 2027 and set a new goal of more than 1,000 trucks by the end of 2027. Q3 revenue was $3 million, the net loss $234 million, and it had about $1.03 billion of cash and short term investments with about $250 million of cash use expected in Q4. It has passed 500,000 commercial driverless miles. No paying air taxi passenger, no final FAA drone rule and no Tesla Dallas launch were confirmed as of Nov 2.

country:argentina.value: 2026-10-30 The Merval fell 1% to 94,530 on Oct 29, a fourth straight loss, while dollar bonds rebounded and country risk eased under 750 points (Ambito). In New York YPF fell 3.10% to 47.81 and ARGT 1.03% to 81.48 (Massive).
country:argentina.was: 2026-10-23 Argentina's country risk rose to 709 points on Oct 22 and the official dollar sold at a nominal record 1,550 pesos at Banco Nacion (wholesale 1,528), while the Merval fell 1.5% to 97,993 as the tech sell off hit ADRs (Rio Times).

country:brazil.value: 2026-11-13 The real fell about 1.05% to 5.6413 per dollar on Nov 12, its weakest close in at least 12 months, as US yields jumped; the Ibovespa fell 0.43% to 171,324.31 (Rio Times; Yahoo Finance).
country:brazil.was: 2026-11-05 Copom held the Selic at 13.75% on Nov 4, unanimously, and ended the cuts that began in March. 72 of 105 institutions expected the hold and 33 a cut to 13.50%, so part of the market was surprised. The statement cited the dollar, El Nino and inflation expectations above target and gave no guidance for December (Poder360, Sou Brasilia, Revista Oeste).

country:china.value: 2026-11-13 Alibaba fell about 7% in US trading and 6.8% in Hong Kong on Nov 12 after Bloomberg reported it rents Nvidia chips through Singapore based Megaspeed, as Commerce reportedly finishes rules to stop Chinese AI developers from using advanced chips in data centers abroad (Bloomberg; Quartz; Reuters). The Senate Banking chair asked Nvidia's former CEO and the Commerce Secretary to testify in December (Investing.com via Yahoo).
country:china.was: 2026-11-09 On Nov 9 China's commerce ministry extended its export control waivers, including the October 2025 rare earth rules due to return Nov 10, to Jan 10, as part of a broader pause in trade countermeasures and tariffs (Reuters via ThePrint). Trump is expected to meet Xi at APEC in Shenzhen later this month.

country:europe.value: 2026-11-12 UK GDP grew 0.7% in Q3 2026, the fastest in two years, with AI related activity cited as one driver despite the oil shock (Reuters Morning Bid, Nov 12). European shares hit record highs on Nov 12 as defensive names offset the Nvidia shock (Investing.com headline via Yahoo).
country:europe.was: 2026-11-11 European chip stocks rose on Nov 11 after CoreWeave's results: Infineon +6.3%, ASMI +5.5%, STMicro +4% and ASML about +3% (CNBC). Siemens Energy posted record quarterly revenue of 12.83 billion euros, while Vestas fell 9.2% on a miss (CNBC).

country:gulf.value: 2026-11-13 The Houthis claimed drone strikes on Saudi oil sites on Nov 12 (Aramco Riyadh, Yanbu refinery, an East West pipeline station); no damage was confirmed. Iran said four tankers burned near Hormuz. Brent settled up 3.3% at $95.82, then held just under $96 on Nov 13 as the IEA saw a supply surplus (Reuters via Euronext; The New Arab; Invezz). XLE rose 1.51% to 64.33 (Yahoo).
country:gulf.was: 2026-11-12 On Nov 12 President Trump wrote that 'we don't need a deal with Iran' and told the Vice President to focus on domestic matters, after the Wall Street Journal reported the Vice President had asked to meet a top Iranian security official. Oil rose on the post; Brent was about $93.50, up 0.8%, at 8:44am ET (Yahoo Finance).

country:india.value: 2026-10-30 The Nifty rose 0.51% to 23,053.10 and the Sensex 0.42% to 74,459.53 on Oct 30, led by IT and pharma, while other Asian markets fell; Infosys rose 2.70% (Business Line, ET Now). Reserves fell a seventh straight week (Reuters).
country:india.was: 2026-10-29 The Sensex rose 905.01 points to 74,151.04 and the Nifty 1.05% to 22,936.75 on Oct 29 after the Fed held, led by banks and consumer stocks (Deccan Herald); the rupee closed at 95.25 per dollar (Economic Times). Brent easing toward $113 helps an oil importer.

country:japan.value: 2026-11-13 The yen weakened past 160 per dollar in Tokyo on Nov 13 after a 159.85 close Nov 12 (MLQ; Reuters). Japan's vice finance minister said recent moves were too rapid; a dollar near 160 came before intervention twice this year. The Nikkei closed up about 0.5% at 61,142.35 (MLQ).
country:japan.was: 2026-11-11 The Nikkei 225 rose 1.31% to 61,248.59 on Nov 11 (CNBC). SoftBank fell 3% after a fiscal Q2 net loss of 1.12 trillion yen (about $7 billion), including losses tied to US AI data center power equipment and Intel shares (CNBC).

country:mexico.value: 2026-10-30 The peso fell 1.2% to about 18.86 per dollar on Oct 29 after strong US growth and inflation data, and Banxico's Borja defended the 6.50% rate (TMGM). Q3 GDP is due Oct 30.
